name: raicho-handoffs
description: Claude Code plugins for session handoffs: a session-close handoff verified in rounds, and a handoff that carries a long session across auto-compaction.

plugins.name: deep-handoff
plugins.description: Write a session-close handoff that survives: a handoff document, durable facts wired into the project's own docs, scripts smoke-tested, and a paste-ready continuation prompt — then verified in rounds, changing the probe each round.

plugins.name: compaction-handoff
plugins.description: Carry a long session across auto-compaction: the session writes a verified handoff before compaction, compaction waits for it, and the handoff's continuation prompt is pasted back into the context afterwards. Depends on deep-handoff.
